profile.label: Habits
profile.value: Bounces a ball off the wall while thinking · Keeps a fixed pre-game routine

p0-dark.monologue: …Did I fall asleep again? It's dark.

p1-mid.monologue: The room seems to have gotten darker.

p1-late.monologue: Going through things one by one, that day keeps coming back to me.

turn-silence.monologue: I don't want to remember. I don't want to face it.

turn-bottom.monologue: …That can't be right. The radio's picking up a different signal.

turn-signal.monologue: The Eungang High gym, they said.

p2-enter.monologue: I have to get there within four nights.

p3-enter.monologue: My parents were hiding something else.

p4-enter.monologue: Mom and Dad's bedroom. First time I've been in here since that day.

resolve.monologue: Bag, ampoule. The bat's by the front door.

report-card-intro.line1: This is my September mock exam report.
report-card-intro.line2: It was the last mock exam before the real one, and my scores were a mess.
report-card-intro.line3: The evening I showed it to them.
report-card-intro.line4: Maybe we should look into a math tutor?
report-card-intro.line5: Studying isn't everything in life, you know.
report-card-intro.line7: I wasn't good enough to get drafted. All that was left was the entrance exam.
report-card-intro.line8: If things were normal, the exam would be… a month away.

ball-intro.line1: I'd done nothing but baseball since I was a kid, so I went to Cheongseo High, a baseball powerhouse.
ball-intro.line2: I play second base, Yunho catches. We've been a pair since youth league.
ball-intro.line3: Summer of my senior year. Nationals round of 16, against Eungang High. Bottom of the ninth, two outs, and I was the last batter.
ball-intro.line4: Yunho called out from the on-deck circle. "You can hit it, Do-hae!"
ball-intro.line5: Their catcher slapped his palm against his mitt twice, thwack thwack, and crouched down.
ball-intro.line6: Like he'd catch anything, no matter how I hit it.

ball-alone.line1: Even when I swing again, my blood doesn't run hot the way it did back then.

console-intro.line1: Haven't played in a while. One round?
console-intro.line2: Juwan and I always played for bets. He was the one losing, almost every time.

console-echo.line2: We said we'd swap characters next time.
console-echo.line3: When it's all over, let's play again.

frame-photo.line1: This photo's from the day we placed at the youth tournament.
frame-photo.line2: Yunho was probably next to me. We've been together ever since then.
frame-photo.line3: …My parents' faces are the only thing I can't see.

phone-stopped.line1: The group chat stopped on the night of October 18.
phone-stopped.line2: The calls I made on the 19th. No one picked up.

window-silence.line1: The first few days, the sirens went all night.
window-silence.line2: Now… there's no sound at all.

calendar-intro.line1: The calendar stopped too, on October 19.

calendar-tally.line1: How many tally marks is that now…
calendar-tally.line2: I stopped counting. The more I count, the longer it feels.

radio-intro.line2: …Not that it'll pick up anything but noise.

duffel-pack.line1: Let's empty out my baseball bag.
duffel-pack.line2: Water, canned food, a flashlight. That should do it.

duffel-take.line1: Water, canned food, a flashlight. It's all in.

fridge-open.line1: If I'm going out, I should take something. Let's start with the fridge.
fridge-open.line2: I've been eating for a month and it's still half full.
fridge-open.line3: Two nights, they said. So why stock this much?

shoes-open.line1: It's been ages since I opened the shoe cabinet.
shoes-open.line2: Dad's hiking boots are still here.
shoes-open.line3: We're keeping it light this time. Just a little loop around nearby.
shoes-open.line4: Light, he said, and yet they left with two whole suitcases.
shoes-open.line5: …The spot where the suitcases go is empty.

cards-intro.line1: There's a note on the table.

cards-memo.line2: The bottom drawer. Does she mean the one in the fridge?
cards-memo.line3: And the two strokes after RX… what was she counting?

computer-power-on.line1: Not like the internet works even if I turn it on.
computer-power-on.line2: …I'll at least look at what's saved.
computer-power-on.line3: …Look how much dust has piled up.

computer-archive.line1: Dad's email. He sounds so excited about the trip.
computer-archive.line2: The news says… it started near a research facility.
computer-archive.line3: The first report was at 3 p.m.

phone-mom-intro.line1: My chat with Mom. I've kept it closed on purpose all this time.
phone-mom-intro.line2: The last message is from that morning.

phone-mom-read.line1: …7:12? The news didn't come out until the afternoon.

ball-echo.line2: Once I'm out of here, I'm hitting again.

ampoule-note.line1: There's a note stuck on the fridge's bottom drawer.
ampoule-note.line2: It's the drawer from Mom's note.

ampoule-found.line1: One ampoule. …The slot next to it is empty.
ampoule-found.line2: Half a logo is left on the label.
ampoule-found.line3: This logo… I've seen it somewhere.

ampoule-taken.line1: Mom and Dad left this behind. I'm taking it with me.

computer-logo-intro.line1: Laon Life Science Institute. I think that logo was in one of Dad's emails.

computer-logo-found.line1: Found it. Same logo as the one on Dad's badge.
computer-logo-found.line2: Tidy up the shelves a bit, will you?

research-note-intro.line1: Papers are scattered across the desk.
research-note-intro.line2: Mom's handwriting. Each piece has a date on it.

research-note-read.line1: So this is what they were working on at Laon.
research-note-read.line2: It wasn't a trip. They were called in to the institute.
research-note-read.line3: RX-11. A candidate cure. …They made two, but there was only one in the case.

id-card-look.line1: Dad's badge. Mom's badge. They left both behind.

id-card-found.line1: Laon Life Science Institute. Dad's name, Mom's name.
id-card-found.line2: Hold it up to the light and a logo appears over the photo. It's the one from the ampoule label.

report-card.title: September Mock Exam
report-card.phase1: My scores were a mess. Mom said to look for a tutor. Dad said it was fine.

console.title: Not fun anymore
console.phase1: Alone, winning and losing feel the same.
console.phase2: Maybe it gets fun again with two.

ball.title: Swinging Alone
ball.phase1: Swinging the bat alone. I wonder what the guys I played with are doing now.
ball.phase2: I'd forgotten what a swing feels like. Once I'm out, I'll hit again.

frame.title: My Parents
frame.phase1: I wiped it clean, and still theirs are the only faces I can't see.
frame.phase2: I pictured my parents' faces and stood the frame back up.

phone.title: The Silence
phone.phase1: The group chat stopped the night before. No one picked up the calls I made that day.
phone.phase2: 7:12 a.m. Mom's last text: come straight home.

calendar.title: October 19
calendar.phase1: I was counting the days with tally marks, then I stopped.

window.title: Outside
window.phase1: Smoke in the distance, a stain on the road, dark windows. I closed the curtains again.

radio.title: That Broadcast
radio.phase1: I'm afraid to face what's really out there.
radio.phase2: Survivors at the Eungang High gym. They leave after four nights. I've heard that voice somewhere.

duffel.title: What to Take
duffel.phase2: I repacked the bag. Almost left the glove, then put it back in.
duffel.phase3: I shouldered the packed bag. The glove is in it.

fridge.title: What They Stocked
fridge.phase2: A month of eating, and half is still left. Why this much for two nights?

shoes.title: The Boots They Left
shoes.phase2: The hiking boots are still here, but they took two suitcases.

cards.title: The Note on the Table
cards.phase2: "Bottom drawer. RX ||" Mom's note on the table.

computer.title: What Was Saved
computer.phase2: It started near a research facility. First report: 3 p.m.
computer.phase3: Dad's email: the Laon logo, and one line. "Tidy up the shelves."

ampoule.title: A Mysterious Ampoule
ampoule.phase2: One ampoule in the case, the next slot empty. A half-worn logo on the label.
ampoule.phase3: I took the ampoule. The one that might be a cure.

research-note.title: Research Log
research-note.phase2: This was their research. The ampoule: a candidate cure. The trip: a summons.

id-card.title: Access Badges
id-card.phase2: Laon access badges. The hologram bears the logo from the ampoule label.

cut1.line1: Past entrance-exam questions. …Han Do-hae. That's my handwriting.
cut1.line2: I retired from the baseball team after the summer tournament. After that, I went back to being just another senior.
cut1.line3: I bought this back then, too. Figured I'd at least act like a test-taker.

cut1.line1: Juwan was in my class. He wasn't even on the baseball team, but he's the one I hung out with most.
cut1.line2: The week exams ended, he'd come over to my place and we'd play fighting games in two-player mode.
cut1.line3: Whenever he lost, he'd always ask for just one more round.
cut1.line4: We said we'd swap characters next time.
cut1.line5: …I can't remember the last time we played.

cut1.line1: Eungang High is just one neighborhood over. They were a tough matchup every time we met.
cut1.line2: Bottom of the ninth, full count. I got under it, and the ball popped up high behind Eungang's catcher.
cut1.line3: He tossed his mask, ran it down, and caught it. That was my last game.
cut1.line4: Losing stung, but strangely, the only thing that stuck with me was the sound of that catcher slapping his mitt.
cut1.line5: I wonder what the guys I played with that day are doing now.

cut1.line1: Nothing but noise, as expected. …That day, there was a broadcast coming out of this thing.

cut3.line1: …This is an emergency broadcast. An infectious disease of unknown origin has broken out. All citizens must take shelter indoors immediately.
cut3.line2: The infection has spread past the capital region into the entire south.
cut3.line3: The infection has now reached Busan. …Repeat. This is an emergency broadcast.

cut4.line2: After extra classes, I checked my phone and there was a text from Mom.
cut4.line3: "Skip the study room today and come straight home." …Not something she usually said.

cut5.line2: A car sitting there with its door open. No one around.
cut5.line4: Still, nothing happened all the way to my door.

cut6.line1: Someone was standing in the hallway.
cut6.line2: …Something about the way they stood was off.

cut9.line2: The sounds behind me weren't human.

cut10.line2: Mom and Dad were away on their trip. There was no one home.
cut10.line3: It was so quiet that what had just happened felt like a lie.

cut11.line1: I turned on the TV, and the news was on.
cut11.line2: Infection, spread, evacuation. The anchor was rattling off unfamiliar words in a panic.
cut11.line3: Screams came from every direction. I covered my ears.

cut12.line1: Ever since that day, I haven't set foot outside.
cut12.line2: Because I was afraid of what I'd have to face out there.

cut4.line1: Testing, testing. Anyone out there? …Is this thing even transmitting?

cut5.line1: We've got survivors gathered here at the Eungang High gym.

cut7.line1: I hooked a transmitter up to the broadcast room gear, so it won't reach far. You'll hear it around here, though.

cut8.line1: After four nights, we're leaving here. Word is a helicopter's coming.

cut9.line1: So if anyone's listening, come to the Eungang High gym. …Don't be late.

cut11.line1: Eungang High…? That guy from back then…?

cut1.line1: I've been eating from the fridge for a month, and it's still half full.
cut1.line2: They took two whole suitcases, but left Dad's hiking boots behind.
cut1.line3: They said two nights. …That wasn't two nights' worth of luggage.

cut1.line1: …Was it not a trip at all? They both knew something.

cut1.line2: Mom and Dad called it a trip to protect me. …And they left that behind.

cut2.line1: I'm taking the ampoule and getting to the Eungang High gym within four nights.

cut1.line1: Three years with this bat. All I ever hit with it was a ball.
